title: 5 Truck Transmission Problems That Cost Thousands (Before You Buy in 2027)
description:
Five truck transmission problems that can cost thousands, from GM's 10-speed rear wheel lockup to Ford's F-150 downshift recall, with what the manufacturers did and a transmission checklist for 2027. Every figure comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
3:21 1. GM 10-speed rear wheel lockup
7:44 2. GM 8-speed shudder
11:32 3. Ford F-150 unexpected downshift
14:45 4. Ford 10R80 10-speed
17:26 5. Toyota Tundra and heavy-duty trucks
20:01 Transmission checklist for 2027

Sources:
- J.D. Power, cost to replace a truck transmission: https://www.jdpower.com/cars/shopping-guides/how-much-does-it-cost-to-replace-a-transmission-on-a-truck
- WardsAuto, GM recalls 462K trucks and SUVs for rear wheel lockup: https://www.wardsauto.com/news/archive-auto-gm-recalls-462k-trucks-suv-tranmisssion-rear-wheel-lockup-nhtsa/732952/
- The Drive, GM 10-speed recall gets messier (Feb 24, 2026): https://www.thedrive.com/news/gms-10-speed-transmission-recall-just-got-even-messier
- AutoGuide, GM sued over recalled 10-speed (May 14, 2026): https://www.autoguide.com/auto/manufacturers/gm/gm-is-getting-sued-over-the-recalled-10-speed-automatic-transmission-44633050
- Pickup Truck + SUV Talk, GM wins 8-speed appeal (June 2025): https://pickuptrucktalk.com/2025/06/gm-wins-appeal-on-8-speed-transmission-class-action-lawsuit/
- Top Class Actions, Barba v. GM 8-speed case (Sept 16, 2026): https://topclassactions.com/lawsuit-settlements/lawsuit-news/class-action-claims-gm-hid-sierra-silverado-transmission-defect/
- Motor1, Ford 2026 recalls list (F-150 downshift): https://www.motor1.com/news/789583/ford-2026-recalls-list-models-affected/
- Ford Authority, judge allows F-150 transmission class action to continue (Feb 4, 2026): https://fordauthority.com/2026/02/judge-allows-ford-f-150-transmission-class-action-to-continue/
- Law360 Canada, Ford 10R80 proposed class action: https://www.law360.ca/ca/articles/2322164/proposed-class-action-launched-against-ford-for-vehicle-transmission-issues
- AP via K-LOVE, Toyota recalls 280,000 trucks and SUVs for transmission (Feb 2024): https://www.klove.com/news/us-and-world/toyota-recalls-280-000-pickup-trucks-and-suvs-to-fix-transmission-problem-49076
